content: Awaḍeɛ n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ
Mařa xenni ɣarwem ca n ufewwej di Lmasiḥ, awařen s tayri i wuř, niɣ tamunt n Arruḥ, niɣ řeḥnunect di daxeř d arreḥmet,
kemmřem řefraḥet inu umi ɣa imun array nwem, ad ɣarwem tiři tayri d icten, d řeɛmar d ijjen uřa d uxarraṣ d ijjen.
War tteggem ca uřa d ict n řḥajjet s umɛaned niɣ zi tuffet ixwan, maca ejj kuř ijj ad iweqqar wenneɣni ktar zeg ixef nnes s uwaḍeɛ.
War ixezzar uřa d ijj ɣar ixef nnes waha, maca ejj kuř ijj ad ixzar ɛawed ɣar wenni d as yudsen.
Ejj ad daywem tiři nneyyet i tuɣa ɛawed di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ,
wenni, am iǧa deg warwas n AREBBI, war iḥsib ca d takeccaḍt umi imqudda ak-d AREBBI,
maca issexwa Ixef nnes, iksi ṣṣifet n umsexxar. Netta idweř deg warwas n bnadem, uca ittwaf di furma n bnadem.
Netta isswaḍeɛ Ixef nnes uca idweř iṭṭaɛ ař řmewt, wah, ař řmewt n ṣṣalib.
S uya issuɛřa i-t AREBBI qaɛ sennej uca iwca as Isem sennej i kuř isem,
ḥima deg Yisem n Yasuɛ ad aḍaren marra ifadden nni iǧan deg ujenna u x temmurt u sadu temmurt,
u ḥima ad iched kuř iřes belli Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ d SIDI i uɛuǧi n AREBBI, Babas.
Tifawin di ddunect
S uyenni, a imɛizzen inu, am mammec tuɣa tᵉṭṭaɛem řebda, war iǧi xmi akidwem ǧiɣ waha, řexxu ɛad ktar xmi xawem i ɣa aggʷjeɣ, xedmem s ufeyyeḍ i Tudart nwem s tiggʷudi d tarjijat,
minzi AREBBI d wenni daywem ixeddmen ař ɣa texsem u ad teggem min di tᵉmmeẓřem kenniw.
Ggem marra břa řeɛkaset u břa amcubbec,
ḥima ad tiřim břa řɛib, am tarwa imezdagen n AREBBI inni izeddɣen di řwesṭ n jjiř iɛewwjen d ifarɣen, u ḥima ad tbanem jar asen am tfawin di ddunect,
maḥend ad tiřim di ṭṭweɛ nsen deg wemcan n Tudart, ḥima ad ɣari yiři usemɣar deg wass n Lmasiḥ, war uyureɣ baṭeř niɣ xedmeɣ s walu.
Maca mařa ttᵉttwarucceɣ am yict n tewhibt n useyyeb x tɣarṣt u x tsexxart di ṭṭweɛ n l’iman nwem, ad farḥeɣ ɛawed uca ad arecqeɣ akidwem marra.
Xenni uřa d kenniw, farḥem uca farḥem ɛawed akidi.
Timutiyu d Ipafruditus
Maca necc ssitimeɣ di Siditneɣ Yasuɛ ad awem dd-ssekkeɣ Timutiyu deɣya, ḥima ad iřiɣ x řxaḍar inu xmi ɣa ssneɣ ameddur nwem.
Minzi war ɣari danita uřa d ijjen am necc, wenni ikessin s wemnus x mammec iffeɣ umeddur nwem s cḍaret.
Minzi marra yarezzun di min nsen, war iǧi di min iǧan n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Maca kenniw tessnem taqeǧebt nnes, belli tuɣa ixeddem akidi di tbarreḥt n Řexbar Aṣebḥan am yijj n mmis ɣar babas.
Necc ssitimeɣ ad ɣarwem t-i-dd-ssekkeɣ deɣya, xmi ɣa ẓareɣ mammec ɣa iffeɣ umeddur inu.
Maca ttiqqeɣ di Sidi inu, belli ɛawed necc ad ɣarwem dd-aseɣ deɣya.
Maca ittɣiř ayi belli tuɣa ittxeṣṣa ad dd-awem ssekkeɣ uma Ipafruditus, wenni d amɛawen inu d amsexxar akidi, maca netta ɛawed d rrasul nwem d amsexxar nwem di min ḥdajeɣ.
Minzi tuɣa iweḥḥec aṭṭas ad kenniw iẓar marra, uca tuɣa iksi s wemnus minzi kenniw tesřim belli tuɣa ihřec.
S tidett, tuɣa ihřec ař řmewt, maca AREBBI tuɣa yarḥem i-t, war iǧi netta waha, aḥeqqa uřa d necc, ḥima war ɣari ittiři ufeqquṣ x ufeqquṣ.
S uyenni ssekkeɣ t s tazřa aṭṭas, ḥima, xmi t ɣa tẓarem ɛawed, ad tfarḥem uca ad dayi yiři drus n wemnus.
S uyenni qebřem t di SIDI, s marra řefraḥet, weqqarem inni iǧan am wanita,
minzi x ssibbet n řxedmet n Lmasiḥ, tuɣa iqarreb ɣar řmewt am isebbeř tudart n yixef nnes, maḥend ad ikemmeř min ineqṣen di tsexxart nwem i necc.
